verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. First half: VariableGaugeMean.density with ell := qLength (2*h) = √(coordinateQ …) is literally (√q)⁻¹ · ρ̂(r/√q), i.e. the paper's q^{-1/2}ρ̂(r/√q), once q^{-1/2} is read as (√q)⁻¹; the z- and t-dependence enters through the point z = (r,(t,Y)) at which q is evaluated rather than as explicit arguments. The bump ρ̂ is PressureStream.rho, a normalized ContDiffBump with ∫ρ̂ = 1 (rho_integral) and support ⊆ [a,b] (rho_support) for free endpoints a < b, so the Lean does not tie the support to the I_m of eq-p092-1 at the point of definition — the containment is supplied by the hypotheses of the call sites. Second half: ρ = Q^{1/2}ρ_phys is not a stipulation in Lean but the derived identity density_chart, whose factor (chartScale n)⁻¹ equals (Q n ^ (-(1/2)))⁻¹ = Q n ^ (1/2) by MeanChartCompatibility.chartScale; i.e. the chart representative at the pulled-back point is Q^{1/2} times the physical one.
